integration_scope.purpose: Import or sync Wetu content into the Tour Operator content model.

verification_checks: Confirm Tour Operator core is installed and active.
Confirm Wetu Importer is installed, active and versioned.
Confirm Wetu settings without exposing credentials.
Confirm import target post types, mappings, source IDs, sync logs and manual override behaviour before running imports.
Verify imported images, itineraries and relationships after sync.
open_questions: Confirm exact option keys and whether scheduled jobs, custom tables, logs or persistent Wetu source IDs exist.
Confirm conflict handling when Wetu data and manually edited WordPress data differ.
